(Japanese: １ Episode 1) is the first regular chapter of the Pocket Monster: Liko's treasure manga. It was first published in the June 2023 issue of Ciao, released on May 2, 2023. It is based on the Pokémon Horizons: The Series episode The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One). It is 32 pages long.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Liko receives a as her first partner Pokémon.
Liko meets Amethio and gets on the radar of the mysterious Explorers organization.
Liko meets Pokémon Professor Friede for the first time.
